1	package queue
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"sync"
7		"sync/atomic"
8		"time"
9	)
10	
11	// Priority determines the time budget for a queued request.
12	type Priority int
13	
14	const (
15		PriorityHigh   Priority = 0 // chat completions: 30s budget
16		PriorityMedium Priority = 1 // completions: 15s budget
17		PriorityLow    Priority = 2 // embeddings/rerank: 5s budget
18	)
19	
20	var defaultBudgets = [3]time.Duration{
21		30 * time.Second,
22		15 * time.Second,
23		5 * time.Second,
24	}
25	
26	var (
27		// ErrQueueFull is returned when the global depth cap is exceeded.
28		ErrQueueFull = errors.New("queue at capacity")
29		// ErrModelEvicted is returned when the model is evicted while the ticket is waiting.
30		ErrModelEvicted = errors.New("model evicted")
31	)
32	
33	// LoadFunc loads a model and returns its backend address and a release function.
34	// The release function must be called when the proxied request completes.
35	type LoadFunc func(ctx context.Context, model string) (addr string, release func(), err error)
36	
37	// Ticket represents a queued request. Returned immediately by Enqueue.
38	type Ticket struct {
39		ready chan string
40		mu    sync.Mutex
41		err   error
42		rel   func()
43		once  sync.Once
44	}
45	
46	// Ready returns a channel that receives the backend address on success,
47	// or is closed without a value on failure. Call Err() to inspect the cause.
48	func (t *Ticket) Ready() <-chan string {
49		return t.ready
50	}
51	
52	// Err returns the failure cause. Must be called after Ready() closes or is drained.
53	func (t *Ticket) Err() error {
54		t.mu.Lock()
55		defer t.mu.Unlock()
56		return t.err
57	}
58	
59	// Release decrements the in-flight counter. Must be called exactly once after the request completes.
60	func (t *Ticket) Release() {
61		t.once.Do(func() {
62			t.mu.Lock()
63			rel := t.rel
64			t.mu.Unlock()
65			if rel != nil {
66				rel()
67			}
68		})
69	}
70	
71	func (t *Ticket) succeed(addr string, rel func()) {
72		t.mu.Lock()
73		t.rel = rel
74		t.mu.Unlock()
75		t.ready <- addr
76	}
77	
78	func (t *Ticket) fail(err error) {
79		t.mu.Lock()
80		t.err = err
81		t.mu.Unlock()
82		close(t.ready)
83	}
84	
85	// modelQueue serializes initial loading for a single model.
86	// Concurrent callers coalesce: the first (primary) calls the loader; subsequent callers
87	// wait for the primary to finish, then call the loader themselves (which returns immediately
88	// since the model is already loaded at that point).
89	type modelQueue struct {
90		mu          sync.Mutex
91		loading     bool
92		loadDone    chan struct{}
93		evictCtx    context.Context
94		evictCancel context.CancelFunc
95	}
96	
97	func (mq *modelQueue) load(ctx context.Context, loader LoadFunc, model string) (string, func(), error) {
98		mq.mu.Lock()
99		if mq.loading {
100			done := mq.loadDone
101			mq.mu.Unlock()
102			select {
103			case <-done:
104			case <-ctx.Done():
105				return "", nil, ctx.Err()
106			}
107			// Primary finished. Model is now loaded; this call returns immediately.
108			return loader(ctx, model)
109		}
110		// This goroutine is the primary loader.
111		mq.loading = true
112		done := make(chan struct{})
113		mq.loadDone = done
114		mq.mu.Unlock()
115	
116		addr, rel, err := loader(ctx, model)
117	
118		mq.mu.Lock()
119		mq.loading = false
120		mq.mu.Unlock()
121		close(done)
122	
123		return addr, rel, err
124	}
125	
126	// Queue manages per-model request queuing with time-bounded priority budgets.
127	type Queue struct {
128		mu       sync.Mutex
129		models   map[string]*modelQueue
130		depth    atomic.Int64
131		maxDepth int64
132		loader   LoadFunc
133		budgets  [3]time.Duration
134	}
135	
136	// New creates a Queue with the given depth cap and loader function.
137	func New(maxDepth int, loader LoadFunc) *Queue {
138		return &Queue{
139			models:   make(map[string]*modelQueue),
140			maxDepth: int64(maxDepth),
141			loader:   loader,
142			budgets:  defaultBudgets,
143		}
144	}
145	
146	// Enqueue registers a request for the given model at the specified priority.
147	// Returns a Ticket immediately; the caller waits on ticket.Ready() for the backend address.
148	func (q *Queue) Enqueue(model string, prio Priority, reqCtx context.Context) *Ticket {
149		if q.depth.Add(1) > q.maxDepth {
150			q.depth.Add(-1)
151			t := &Ticket{ready: make(chan string, 1)}
152			t.fail(ErrQueueFull)
153			return t
154		}
155	
156		q.mu.Lock()
157		mq, ok := q.models[model]
158		if !ok {
159			evictCtx, evictCancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
160			mq = &modelQueue{
161				evictCtx:    evictCtx,
162				evictCancel: evictCancel,
163			}
164			q.models[model] = mq
165		}
166		q.mu.Unlock()
167	
168		t := &Ticket{ready: make(chan string, 1)}
169	
170		go func() {
171			defer q.depth.Add(-1)
172	
173			// Combined context: cancelled by request cancellation or the priority budget.
174			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(reqCtx, q.budgets[prio])
175			defer cancel()
176	
177			// Also watch for model eviction; cancel the load context if evicted.
178			go func() {
179				select {
180				case <-mq.evictCtx.Done():
181					cancel()
182				case <-ctx.Done():
183				}
184			}()
185	
186			addr, rel, err := mq.load(ctx, q.loader, model)
187			if err != nil {
188				select {
189				case <-mq.evictCtx.Done():
190					t.fail(ErrModelEvicted)
191				default:
192					t.fail(err)
193				}
194				return
195			}
196	
197			// Load succeeded, but eviction may have raced. Check before serving.
198			select {
199			case <-mq.evictCtx.Done():
200				if rel != nil {
201					rel()
202				}
203				t.fail(ErrModelEvicted)
204				return
205			default:
206			}
207	
208			t.succeed(addr, rel)
209		}()
210	
211		return t
212	}
213	
214	// CancelModel cancels all tickets for the given model with ErrModelEvicted.
215	// Call this when a model is being evicted by the process manager.
216	func (q *Queue) CancelModel(model string) {
217		q.mu.Lock()
218		mq, ok := q.models[model]
219		if ok {
220			delete(q.models, model)
221		}
222		q.mu.Unlock()
223		if ok {
224			mq.evictCancel()
225		}
226	}

1	package process
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"log/slog"
8		"net/http"
9		"os"
10		"os/exec"
11		"sort"
12		"strconv"
13		"sync"
14		"sync/atomic"
15		"syscall"
16		"time"
17	
18		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/config"
19		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/monitor"
20		"github.com/nogo/wire/internal/vram"
21	)
22	
23	// modelState represents the lifecycle state of a managed model process.
24	type modelState int
25	
26	const (
27		stateIdle      modelState = iota // not loaded or failed
28		stateLoading                     // llama-server starting up
29		stateLoaded                      // loaded and serving requests
30		stateUnloading                   // unloading: SIGTERM sent, waiting for exit
31	)
32	
33	func (s modelState) String() string {
34		switch s {
35		case stateIdle:
36			return "idle"
37		case stateLoading:
38			return "loading"
39		case stateLoaded:
40			return "loaded"
41		case stateUnloading:
42			return "unloading"
43		default:
44			return "unknown"
45		}
46	}
47	
48	type procState struct {
49		mu        sync.Mutex
50		modelName string
51		params    config.ModelParams
52		port      int
53		proc      *exec.Cmd
54		startedAt time.Time
55		restarts  int
56		isWarmup  bool
57	
58		// State machine. state and ready are always updated together under mu.
59		state   modelState
60		ready   chan struct{} // closed when loading completes (success or failure); nil when idle
61		loadErr error         // non-nil if the most recent load attempt failed
62	
63		// In-flight tracking and LRU.
64		inflight atomic.Int64
65		lastUsed time.Time
66	
67		// Per-model lifecycle control.
68		cancel context.CancelFunc
69		wg     sync.WaitGroup // Done when the supervisor goroutine exits
70	}
71	
72	// addInflight increments the in-flight counter and updates lastUsed.
73	// Returns the address, release function, and no error.
74	func (ps *procState) addInflight(port int) (addr string, release func(), err error) {
75		ps.inflight.Add(1)
76		ps.mu.Lock()
77		ps.lastUsed = time.Now()
78		ps.mu.Unlock()
79		return fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", port), func() { ps.inflight.Add(-1) }, nil
80	}
81	
82	// Manager supervises llama-server child processes.
83	type Manager struct {
84		cfg        *config.Config
85		log        *slog.Logger
86		cmdBuilder func(ctx context.Context, modelName string, params config.ModelParams) *exec.Cmd
87	
88		// healthTimeout overrides the 120s waitHealthy timeout. Zero means 120s.
89		// Set in tests to speed up failure scenarios.
90		healthTimeout time.Duration
91	
92		// vram is the optional VRAM tracker for admission control. nil = count-only.
93		vram *vram.Tracker
94	
95		// drainTimeout is the max time to wait for in-flight requests to complete
96		// before sending SIGTERM. Zero means 30s.
97		drainTimeout time.Duration
98	
99		mu      sync.RWMutex
100		procs   map[string]*procState
101		ctx     context.Context    // manager root context (detached from any HTTP request)
102		wg      sync.WaitGroup     // Done when all supervisors exit
103		cancel  context.CancelFunc // cancels m.ctx
104		eventCh chan monitor.ServerEvent
105	}
106	
107	// New creates a Manager. It does not start any processes; call Start.
108	func New(cfg *config.Config, log *slog.Logger) *Manager {
109		m := new(Manager)
110		m.cfg = cfg
111		m.log = log
112		m.procs = make(map[string]*procState)
113		m.eventCh = make(chan monitor.ServerEvent, 256)
114		m.cmdBuilder = func(ctx context.Context, modelName string, params config.ModelParams) *exec.Cmd {
115			return exec.CommandContext(ctx, "llama-server", buildArgs(modelName, params)...)
116		}
117		return m
118	}
119	
120	// SetCmdBuilder replaces the default llama-server launcher. Used in tests to
121	// inject a fake process builder without starting real llama-server instances.
122	func (m *Manager) SetCmdBuilder(fn func(ctx context.Context, modelName string, params config.ModelParams) *exec.Cmd) {
123		m.cmdBuilder = fn
124	}
125	
126	// SetVRAMTracker attaches a VRAM tracker for VRAM-aware admission control.
127	// When nil (default), only the max_models count limit is enforced.
128	func (m *Manager) SetVRAMTracker(t *vram.Tracker) { m.vram = t }
129	
130	// effectiveDrainTimeout returns the configured drain timeout or the default 30s.
131	func (m *Manager) effectiveDrainTimeout() time.Duration {
132		if m.drainTimeout > 0 {
133			return m.drainTimeout
134		}
135		return 30 * time.Second
136	}
137	
138	// drainAndCancel waits up to drainTimeout for in-flight requests to complete,
139	// then cancels the model's context to initiate SIGTERM. Must NOT hold m.mu.
140	func (m *Manager) drainAndCancel(ps *procState) {
141		deadline := time.Now().Add(m.effectiveDrainTimeout())
142		for ps.inflight.Load() > 0 {
143			remaining := time.Until(deadline)
144			if remaining <= 0 {
145				m.log.Warn("drain timeout exceeded, forcing shutdown", "model", ps.modelName)
146				break
147			}
148			sleep := 10 * time.Millisecond
149			if remaining < sleep {
150				sleep = remaining
151			}
152			time.Sleep(sleep)
153		}
154		ps.cancel()
155	}
156	
157	// Events returns a receive-only channel of structured events from all managed processes.
158	func (m *Manager) Events() <-chan monitor.ServerEvent {
159		return m.eventCh
160	}
161	
162	// Snapshot returns a point-in-time snapshot of all managed processes.
163	func (m *Manager) Snapshot() []monitor.BackendStatus {
164		m.mu.RLock()
165		defer m.mu.RUnlock()
166	
167		result := make([]monitor.BackendStatus, 0, len(m.procs))
168		for _, ps := range m.procs {
169			ps.mu.Lock()
170			pid := 0
171			if ps.proc != nil && ps.proc.Process != nil {
172				pid = ps.proc.Process.Pid
173			}
174			status := monitor.BackendStatus{
175				Name:      ps.modelName,
176				Model:     ps.modelName,
177				Port:      ps.port,
178				PID:       pid,
179				Loaded:    ps.state == stateLoaded,
180				Status:    ps.state.String(),
181				StartedAt: ps.startedAt,
182				Restarts:  ps.restarts,
183			}
184			ps.mu.Unlock()
185			result = append(result, status)
186		}
187		return result
188	}
189	
190	// RunningModels returns model names of all currently healthy processes.
191	func (m *Manager) RunningModels() []string {
192		m.mu.RLock()
193		defer m.mu.RUnlock()
194		var names []string
195		for name, ps := range m.procs {
196			ps.mu.Lock()
197			healthy := ps.state == stateLoaded
198			ps.mu.Unlock()
199			if healthy {
200				names = append(names, name)
201			}
202		}
203		return names
204	}
205	
206	// ListModels returns all known models in any state except idle.
207	func (m *Manager) ListModels() []monitor.ModelInfo {
208		m.mu.RLock()
209		defer m.mu.RUnlock()
210		result := make([]monitor.ModelInfo, 0, len(m.procs))
211		for _, ps := range m.procs {
212			ps.mu.Lock()
213			state := ps.state
214			name := ps.modelName
215			ps.mu.Unlock()
216			if state != stateIdle {
217				result = append(result, monitor.ModelInfo{ID: name, Status: state.String()})
218			}
219		}
220		return result
221	}
222	
223	// Start launches supervisor goroutines for all warmup models.
224	// It returns immediately; health checks happen asynchronously.
225	func (m *Manager) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
226		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
227		m.ctx = ctx
228		m.cancel = cancel
229	
230		for _, modelName := range m.cfg.Warmup {
231			params, ok := m.cfg.MatchModel(modelName)
232			if !ok {
233				cancel()
234				return fmt.Errorf("warmup model %q does not match any pattern", modelName)
235			}
236			if err := m.startSupervisor(modelName, params, true); err != nil {
237				cancel()
238				return err
239			}
240		}
241		return nil
242	}
243	
244	// startSupervisor creates a procState and launches the supervisor goroutine.
245	// Must NOT hold m.mu.
246	func (m *Manager) startSupervisor(modelName string, params config.ModelParams, isWarmup bool) error {
247		modelCtx, modelCancel := context.WithCancel(m.ctx)
248		ps := &procState{
249			modelName: modelName,
250			params:    params,
251			state:     stateLoading,
252			ready:     make(chan struct{}),
253			cancel:    modelCancel,
254			isWarmup:  isWarmup,
255		}
256	
257		m.mu.Lock()
258		m.procs[modelName] = ps
259		m.mu.Unlock()
260	
261		m.wg.Add(1)
262		ps.wg.Add(1)
263		go m.supervise(modelCtx, modelName)

267	// Reload applies newCfg to the running manager. Models whose params changed are
268	// drained and restarted; models no longer matching any pattern are drained and
269	// removed; new warmup entries are started. Models with unchanged params keep
270	// serving without interruption.
271	//
272	// Global fields that require a process restart (e.g. listen address) are logged
273	// as warnings but not applied.
274	func (m *Manager) Reload(newCfg *config.Config) {
275		if m.cfg.Listen != newCfg.Listen {
276			m.log.Warn("listen address changed; requires restart to take effect",
277				"old", m.cfg.Listen, "new", newCfg.Listen)
278		}
279	
280		type drainOp struct {
281			name      string
282			ps        *procState
283			newParams config.ModelParams
284			restart   bool
285			isWarmup  bool
286		}
287	
288		newWarmupSet := make(map[string]bool, len(newCfg.Warmup))
289		for _, name := range newCfg.Warmup {
290			newWarmupSet[name] = true
291		}
292	
293		m.mu.Lock()
294		m.cfg = newCfg
295	
296		var ops []drainOp
297		for name, ps := range m.procs {
298			ps.mu.Lock()
299			state := ps.state
300			oldParams := ps.params
301			wasWarmup := ps.isWarmup
302			ps.mu.Unlock()
303	
304			if state != stateLoaded && state != stateLoading {
305				continue
306			}
307	
308			newParams, ok := newCfg.MatchModel(name)
309			if !ok {
310				m.log.Info("draining removed model", "model", name)
311				ps.mu.Lock()
312				ps.state = stateUnloading
313				ps.mu.Unlock()
314				ops = append(ops, drainOp{name: name, ps: ps})
315				continue
316			}
317	
318			if !oldParams.Equal(newParams) {
319				m.log.Info("reloading model", "model", name)
320				ps.mu.Lock()
321				ps.state = stateUnloading
322				ps.mu.Unlock()
323				ops = append(ops, drainOp{
324					name:      name,
325					ps:        ps,
326					newParams: newParams,
327					restart:   true,
328					isWarmup:  wasWarmup || newWarmupSet[name],
329				})
330				continue
331			}
332	
333			if wasWarmup && !newWarmupSet[name] {
334				m.log.Info("draining removed warmup model", "model", name)
335				ps.mu.Lock()
336				ps.state = stateUnloading
337				ps.mu.Unlock()
338				ops = append(ops, drainOp{name: name, ps: ps})
339			}
340		}
341		m.mu.Unlock()
342	
343		// Cancel all affected models simultaneously, then wait for each to exit.
344		// This runs outside m.mu to avoid deadlocking with the supervisor goroutine.
345		for i := range ops {
346			ops[i].ps.cancel()
347		}
348		for i := range ops {
349			ops[i].ps.wg.Wait()
350		}
351	
352		m.mu.Lock()
353		for i := range ops {
354			delete(m.procs, ops[i].name)
355		}
356		m.mu.Unlock()
357	
358		// Restart models whose params changed.
359		for _, op := range ops {
360			if op.restart {
361				if err := m.startSupervisor(op.name, op.newParams, op.isWarmup); err != nil {
362					m.log.Error("failed to restart model after reload", "model", op.name, "error", err)
363				}
364			}
365		}
366	
367		// Start new warmup models not currently in procs.
368		for _, name := range newCfg.Warmup {
369			m.mu.RLock()
370			_, exists := m.procs[name]
371			m.mu.RUnlock()
372			if exists {
373				continue
374			}
375			params, ok := newCfg.MatchModel(name)
376			if !ok {
377				continue
378			}
379			m.log.Info("starting new warmup model", "model", name)
380			if err := m.startSupervisor(name, params, true); err != nil {
381				m.log.Error("failed to start new warmup model", "model", name, "error", err)
382			}
383		}
384	}

424	// LoadOrGet returns a LoadTicket for the named model, loading it on demand if
425	// necessary. The ticket's Ready() channel receives the backend address when the
426	// model is healthy, or is closed on failure. Concurrent calls for the same
427	// unloaded model coalesce — one process starts and all waiters get the result.
428	//
429	// The caller must call ticket.Release() (typically via defer) when the proxied
430	// request completes to decrement the in-flight counter.
431	func (m *Manager) LoadOrGet(modelName string, params config.ModelParams) *LoadTicket {
432		ticket := newTicket()
433	
434		// Fast path: check under read lock to avoid goroutine overhead for
435		// the common already-loaded case.
436		m.mu.RLock()
437		ps, ok := m.procs[modelName]
438		m.mu.RUnlock()
439		if ok {
440			ps.mu.Lock()
441			state := ps.state
442			port := ps.port
443			ready := ps.ready
444			ps.mu.Unlock()
445	
446			switch state {
447			case stateLoaded:
448				addr, rel, _ := ps.addInflight(port)
449				ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
450				return ticket
451			case stateLoading:
452				go func() {
453					<-ready
454					addr, rel, err := m.checkLoaded(modelName)
455					if err != nil {
456						ticket.fail(err)
457					} else {
458						ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
459					}
460				}()
461				return ticket
462			case stateUnloading:
463				ticket.fail(fmt.Errorf("model %q is shutting down", modelName))
464				return ticket
465			}
466		}
467	
468		var estimate uint64
469		if m.vram != nil {
470			estimate = m.vram.EstimateForModel(modelName)
471		}
472		go m.startLoad(ticket, modelName, params, estimate)
473		return ticket
474	}

476	// startLoad is the slow path of LoadOrGet: acquires the write lock, evicts if
477	// needed, and either joins an in-progress load or starts a new supervisor.
478	func (m *Manager) startLoad(ticket *LoadTicket, modelName string, params config.ModelParams, estimate uint64) {
479		m.mu.Lock()
480	
481		// Re-check state under write lock; may have changed since fast-path check.
482		if ps, ok := m.procs[modelName]; ok {
483			ps.mu.Lock()
484			state := ps.state
485			ready := ps.ready
486			port := ps.port
487			ps.mu.Unlock()
488	
489			switch state {
490			case stateLoaded:
491				m.mu.Unlock()
492				addr, rel, _ := ps.addInflight(port)
493				ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
494				return
495			case stateLoading:
496				m.mu.Unlock()
497				<-ready
498				addr, rel, err := m.checkLoaded(modelName)
499				if err != nil {
500					ticket.fail(err)
501				} else {
502					ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
503				}
504				return
505			case stateUnloading:
506				m.mu.Unlock()
507				ticket.fail(fmt.Errorf("model %q is shutting down", modelName))
508				return
509			case stateIdle:
510				delete(m.procs, modelName)
511			}
512		}
513	
514		if err := m.evictIfNeeded(modelName, estimate); err != nil {
515			m.mu.Unlock()
516			ticket.fail(err)
517			return
518		}
519	
520		// evictIfNeeded releases and re-acquires m.mu; re-check for concurrent loads.
521		if ps2, ok := m.procs[modelName]; ok {
522			ps2.mu.Lock()
523			state2 := ps2.state
524			ready2 := ps2.ready
525			port2 := ps2.port
526			ps2.mu.Unlock()
527			switch state2 {
528			case stateLoaded:
529				m.mu.Unlock()
530				addr, rel, _ := ps2.addInflight(port2)
531				ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
532				return
533			case stateLoading:
534				m.mu.Unlock()
535				<-ready2
536				addr, rel, err := m.checkLoaded(modelName)
537				if err != nil {
538					ticket.fail(err)
539				} else {
540					ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
541				}
542				return
543			}
544		}
545	
546		// Start a new supervisor.
547		modelCtx, modelCancel := context.WithCancel(m.ctx)
548		ps := &procState{
549			modelName: modelName,
550			params:    params,
551			state:     stateLoading,
552			ready:     make(chan struct{}),
553			cancel:    modelCancel,
554			isWarmup:  false,
555		}
556		m.procs[modelName] = ps
557		ready := ps.ready
558		m.mu.Unlock()
559	
560		m.publishEvent(monitor.ServerEvent{
561			Time:    time.Now(),
562			Backend: modelName,
563			Kind:    monitor.EventModelLoad,
564			Message: "loading on demand",
565		})
566	
567		m.wg.Add(1)
568		ps.wg.Add(1)
569		go m.supervise(modelCtx, modelName)
570	
571		<-ready
572		addr, rel, err := m.checkLoaded(modelName)
573		if err != nil {
574			ticket.fail(err)
575		} else {
576			ticket.succeed(addr, rel)
577		}
578	}

581	func (m *Manager) checkLoaded(modelName string) (addr string, release func(), err error) {

583		ps, ok := m.procs[modelName]
584		m.mu.RUnlock()

586		if !ok {
587			return "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("model %q load failed", modelName)

590		ps.mu.Lock()
591		state := ps.state
592		loadErr := ps.loadErr
593		port := ps.port
594		ps.mu.Unlock()

606	// evictIfNeeded evicts the minimum set of idle models needed to admit a new
607	// model, enforcing both the max_models count limit and the VRAM budget.
608	//
609	// Must be called with m.mu write-locked. It releases and re-acquires m.mu
610	// while draining evicted supervisors, so the caller must re-validate procs
611	// state after it returns.
612	func (m *Manager) evictIfNeeded(modelName string, estimate uint64) error {
613		type candidate struct {
614			name     string
615			ps       *procState
616			lastUsed time.Time
617			vramEst  uint64
618		}
619		var candidates []candidate
620		running := 0
621	
622		for name, ps := range m.procs {
623			ps.mu.Lock()
624			state := ps.state
625			lu := ps.lastUsed
626			ps.mu.Unlock()
627	
628			if state != stateIdle {
629				running++
630			}
631			if state == stateLoaded && ps.inflight.Load() == 0 {
632				vramEst := uint64(0)
633				if m.vram != nil {
634					vramEst = m.vram.EstimateForModel(name)
635				}
636				candidates = append(candidates, candidate{name: name, ps: ps, lastUsed: lu, vramEst: vramEst})
637			}
638		}
639	
640		needCountEvict := m.cfg.MaxModels > 0 && running >= m.cfg.MaxModels
641		needVRAMEvict := m.vram != nil && estimate > 0 && m.vram.FreeVRAM() < estimate
642	
643		if !needCountEvict && !needVRAMEvict {
644			return nil
645		}
646		if len(candidates) == 0 {
647			if needVRAMEvict && !needCountEvict {
648				return fmt.Errorf("insufficient VRAM for %q; all loaded models have in-flight requests", modelName)
649			}
650			return fmt.Errorf("at capacity (%d/%d models); all loaded models have in-flight requests", running, m.cfg.MaxModels)
651		}
652	
653		// Sort LRU: oldest first (evict least-recently-used first).
654		sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
655			return candidates[i].lastUsed.Before(candidates[j].lastUsed)
656		})
657	
658		// Greedily select the minimum number of victims (LRU order) that satisfies
659		// both the count constraint and the VRAM budget.
660		var victims []candidate
661		countSatisfied := !needCountEvict
662		vramSatisfied := !needVRAMEvict
663		free := uint64(0)
664		if m.vram != nil {
665			free = m.vram.FreeVRAM()
666		}
667		vramFreed := uint64(0)
668	
669		for _, c := range candidates {
670			victims = append(victims, c)
671			running--
672			vramFreed += c.vramEst
673	
674			if !countSatisfied && running < m.cfg.MaxModels {
675				countSatisfied = true
676			}
677			if !vramSatisfied && free+vramFreed >= estimate {
678				vramSatisfied = true
679			}
680			if countSatisfied && vramSatisfied {
681				break
682			}
683		}
684	
685		if !countSatisfied || !vramSatisfied {
686			return fmt.Errorf("at capacity; cannot free enough resources for model %q", modelName)
687		}
688	
689		// Mark all victims as unloading and release their VRAM reservations before
690		// dropping the lock — new requests will be rejected immediately.
691		for i := range victims {
692			victims[i].ps.mu.Lock()
693			victims[i].ps.state = stateUnloading
694			victims[i].ps.mu.Unlock()
695			if m.vram != nil {
696				m.vram.Release(victims[i].name)
697			}
698			m.log.Info("evicting model (LRU)", "model", victims[i].name)
699			m.publishEvent(monitor.ServerEvent{
700				Time:    time.Now(),
701				Backend: victims[i].name,
702				Kind:    monitor.EventModelLoad,
703				Message: "unloading (LRU eviction)",
704			})
705		}
706	
707		// Release the manager lock while draining all victims concurrently.
708		m.mu.Unlock()
709		for _, v := range victims {
710			m.drainAndCancel(v.ps)
711			v.ps.wg.Wait()
712		}
713		m.mu.Lock()
714		for _, v := range victims {
715			delete(m.procs, v.name)
716		}
717		return nil
718	}

736	// supervise is the per-model restart loop. It runs until ctx is cancelled
737	// or (for on-demand models) until the first load attempt fails or the process
738	// exits after becoming healthy.
739	func (m *Manager) supervise(ctx context.Context, modelName string) {
740		defer m.wg.Done()
741	
742		m.mu.RLock()
743		ps := m.procs[modelName]
744		m.mu.RUnlock()
745	
746		// Ensure state is idle and the ready channel is closed on exit (for any
747		// reason). This unblocks callers waiting in LoadOrGet and lets Loaded()
748		// return false after the supervisor exits.
749		defer func() {
750			ps.wg.Done()
751			ps.mu.Lock()
752			ready := ps.ready
753			ps.ready = nil
754			// Only preserve stateUnloading; evictIfNeeded owns that transition.
755			if ps.state != stateUnloading {
756				ps.state = stateIdle
757			}
758			ps.mu.Unlock()
759			if ready != nil {
760				close(ready)
761			}
762		}()
763	
764		const (
765			maxRetries  = 5
766			retryWindow = 60 * time.Second
767			backoff     = 2 * time.Second
768		)
769	
770		var (
771			attempts    int
772			windowStart = time.Now()
773			firstLoad   = true
774		)
775	
776		for {
777			select {
778			case <-ctx.Done():
779				return
780			default:
781			}
782	
783			if time.Since(windowStart) > retryWindow {
784				attempts = 0
785				windowStart = time.Now()
786			}
787			if attempts >= maxRetries {
788				m.log.Error("max restart retries exceeded, giving up", "model", modelName)
789				return
790			}
791	
792			if attempts > 0 && ps.isWarmup {
793				// Before retrying a warmup model, create a fresh ready channel so
794				// new callers waiting in LoadOrGet see the correct loading state.
795				ps.mu.Lock()
796				ps.state = stateLoading
797				ps.loadErr = nil
798				ps.ready = make(chan struct{})
799				ps.mu.Unlock()
800	
801				m.log.Info("restarting model", "model", modelName, "attempt", attempts)
802				select {
803				case <-ctx.Done():
804					return
805				case <-time.After(backoff):
806				}
807			}
808	
809			attempts++
810	
811			ps.mu.Lock()
812			if !firstLoad {
813				ps.restarts++
814			}
815			ps.startedAt = time.Now()
816			params := ps.params
817			ps.mu.Unlock()
818	
819			cmd, parser, err := m.launch(ctx, modelName, params)
820			if err != nil {
821				m.log.Error("failed to launch llama-server", "model", modelName, "error", err)
822				if !ps.isWarmup {
823					m.failLoad(ps, modelName, err)
824					return
825				}
826				continue
827			}
828	
829			// Wait for llama-server to report its listening port via stdout.
830			var port int
831			select {
832			case port = <-parser.PortCh:
833			case <-ctx.Done():
834				cmd.Process.Kill()
835				cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
836				return
837			case <-time.After(m.effectiveHealthTimeout()):
838				m.log.Error("timed out waiting for listening port", "model", modelName)
839				cmd.Process.Kill()
840				cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
841				if !ps.isWarmup {
842					m.failLoad(ps, modelName, fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for listening port"))
843					return
844				}
845				continue
846			}
847	
848			ps.mu.Lock()
849			ps.port = port
850			ps.proc = cmd
851			ps.mu.Unlock()
852	
853			loadStart := time.Now()
854			if err := waitHealthy(ctx, port, m.effectiveHealthTimeout()); err != nil {
855				m.log.Error("health check failed on start", "model", modelName, "error", err)
856				cmd.Process.Kill()
857				cmd.Wait() //nolint:errcheck
858				ps.mu.Lock()
859				ps.proc = nil
860				ps.mu.Unlock()
861				if !ps.isWarmup {
862					m.failLoad(ps, modelName, err)
863					return
864				}
865				continue
866			}
867	
868			loadDur := time.Since(loadStart)
869	
870			// Transition to healthy and signal all waiters by closing ready.
871			ps.mu.Lock()
872			ps.state = stateLoaded
873			if firstLoad {
874				ps.lastUsed = time.Now()
875			}
876			ready := ps.ready
877			ps.ready = nil
878			ps.mu.Unlock()
879	
880			if ready != nil {
881				close(ready)
882			}
883			firstLoad = false
884	
885			if m.vram != nil {
886				if est := m.vram.EstimateForModel(modelName); est > 0 {
887					if !m.vram.Reserve(modelName, est) {
888						m.log.Warn("VRAM reservation failed after model load", "model", modelName)
889					}
890				}
891			}
892	
893			m.log.Info("model healthy", "model", modelName, "port", port, "load_duration", loadDur)
894			m.publishEvent(monitor.ServerEvent{
895				Time:       time.Now(),
896				Backend:    modelName,
897				Kind:       monitor.EventModelLoad,
898				DurationMs: float64(loadDur.Milliseconds()),
899				Message:    "loaded",
900			})
901	
902			exitCh := make(chan error, 1)
903			go func() { exitCh <- cmd.Wait() }()
904	
905			select {
906			case <-ctx.Done():
907				<-exitCh
908				return
909	
910			case exitErr := <-exitCh:
911				ps.mu.Lock()
912				ps.state = stateIdle
913				ps.proc = nil
914				ps.mu.Unlock()
915	
916				if ctx.Err() != nil {
917					return
918				}
919	
920				oomKilled := false
921				if exitErr != nil {
922					if ee, ok := errors.AsType[*exec.ExitError](exitErr); ok {
923						// OOM killer sends SIGKILL — detect via WaitStatus.
924						if ws, ok := ee.Sys().(syscall.WaitStatus); ok && ws.Signal() == syscall.SIGKILL {
925							oomKilled = true
926							m.log.Error("process killed by SIGKILL (likely OOM)", "model", modelName)
927						} else {
928							m.log.Warn("process exited unexpectedly", "model", modelName, "exit_code", ee.ExitCode())
929						}
930					} else {
931						m.log.Warn("process exited unexpectedly", "model", modelName, "error", exitErr)
932					}
933				}
934	
935				if !ps.isWarmup {
936					// On-demand model crashed; remove and stop.
937					m.mu.Lock()
938					delete(m.procs, modelName)
939					m.mu.Unlock()
940					return
941				}
942	
943				// OOM: back off longer to let the system recover before reloading.
944				if oomKilled {
945					oomDelay := 30 * time.Second
946					m.log.Warn("delaying restart after OOM kill", "model", modelName, "delay", oomDelay)
947					select {
948					case <-ctx.Done():
949						return
950					case <-time.After(oomDelay):
951					}
